verdict.rationale: TeamViewer documents an AI troubleshooting assistant that users query in natural language for device-specific answers, and an AI agent (Tia) said to help fix IT issues. Its frontline smart-glasses offering also lists hands-free voice-command operation. However, the natural-language interface is shown mainly for getting answers and insights, not for commanding the product to perform actions such as starting sessions or running scripts. Missing for 10: documented natural-language command execution across core product operations, details of what actions Tia can take on command, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: By querying our AI troubleshooting assistant, find faults and fix them fast, using natural language to get real-time, device-specific answers and insights.
Tia, your AI agent, learns from every support session to predict, prevent, and rapidly fix IT issues.
Hands-free operation: Voice commands and sensors replace paper instructions.
